department: College of Engineering and Science with College of Applied and Natural Sciences

deadline.value: The Graduate School's preferred date for international Fall applicants is July 1. The page says some programs have earlier deadlines, and none was found for this program.

gre_subject.value: The program page names no subject GRE.

gre_general.value: The GRE is required, and about 304 total with at least 146 verbal is expected. The PhD Steering Committee may waive it for exceptional students.
gre_general.quote: Official GRE scores are required. It is expected that most applicants will have a minimum total score of 304 in the Verbal and Quantitative Reasoning sections with a minimum of 146 in the Verbal Reasoning section

supervisor.value: You pick a faculty advisor during your first quarter after admission, so an advisor's agreement is not part of admission.
supervisor.quote: During your first quarter of enrollment, you will identify a faculty advisor

funding.value: Graduate assistantships are limited, so not every applicant who asks will get one.
funding.quote: There are a limited number of graduate assistantships, therefore not all students who apply will be granted an assistantship

entry_route.value: Students with only a bachelor's degree can be admitted directly if they show outstanding achievement, but a master's is the expected qualification.
entry_route.quote: Students with Bachelor’s degrees may be admitted directly to the PhD program on the basis of outstanding academic achievements

also.quote: A Master’s degree in biological sciences, biomedical engineering, chemical engineering, chemistry, electrical engineering, physics, or a closely related area is the expected qualification.

notes: Joint program of the College of Applied and Natural Sciences and the College of Engineering and Science. GRE and admission from the 2026-27 catalog. Funding and advisor rules are from the MSNT PhD handbook, dated Winter 2022. The ANS page confirms the PhD.
name: PhD in Molecular Science and Nanotechnology
